name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US strike on Qeshm 6 Nov; Qatar mediates
summary: US strikes Iranian air defences on Qeshm late on 6 Nov; Trump says talks progressing as Qatar mediates
state: President Trump said US forces carried out minor strikes on an Iranian air-defence site on Qeshm Island late on 6 Nov, and Iranian media reported two missiles hit the Suza area; Iran said it downed a US drone, which the US has not confirmed (Al Jazeera). Trump said there had been a lot of progress with Iran, and Qatar said on 7 Nov its mediation continues (Euronews). US Central Command disabled a blockade runner on 7 Nov (RFE/RL).
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which can change at short notice.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping = Alert

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Trump confirms new US strikes on Iran's Qeshm island
Euronews — US launches new targeted strikes on Iran as Trump claims progress in talks
RFE/RL — Iran live blog: US forces disable ship seeking to break blockade

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
